item.title: Surge in worker dormitory rents halts in 2H2025 as supply-demand gap narrows
item.description: Rents for worker dormitories in Singapore declined in 2H2025, reversing from a surge that started in 2019. Data in a March research report jointly published by the Dormitory Association of Singapore Limited (DASL) and Knight Frank Singapore found that the islandwide average monthly rent for a bed in a Class 4 commercial dormitory (which refers to dormitories that can accommodate 1,000 or more workers) inched 1% lower to $485 in 2H2025, from $490 in 1H2025. item.title: Private non-landed housing prices up 0.7% in January: NUS SRPI flash estimate
item.description: The Institute of Real Estate and Urban Studies (IREUS) released the Singapore Residential Price Index for (SRPI) for the month of January on March 2. Flash estimates of the SRPI indicate that prices for non-landed residential homes grew 0.7% m-o-m in January 2026. This comes as overall consumer prices declined 0.5% in January, based on the Singapore Consumer Price Index. item.title: Penthouse at Union Square Residences sold for $18.5 mil to Singapore PR
item.description: The sole penthouse at luxury development Union Square Residences by City Developments Limited (CDL) has fetched $18.5 million ($3,838 psf) in a new sale brokered by Joseph Tan, associate senior sales director at SRI. The buyer is a French national who is a Singapore permanent resident (PR). The caveat for the transaction was lodged on Feb 20. item.title: Sim Lian to preview Rivelle Tampines EC on March 6
item.description: Sim Lian Group has announced it will preview Rivelle Tampines, its 572-unit executive condominium (EC) along Tampines Street 95, on Mar 6. E-applications for the project will open from Mar 6 until Mar 16, while sales bookings will commence on Mar 21. The 99-year leasehold EC is located off Tampines Avenue 1 and is a five-minute walk away from the Tampines West MRT Station on the Downtown Line. item.title: Cairnhill Road conservation terraced house for sale at $16 mil
item.description: A freehold corner terraced house at 124 Cairnhill Road in District 9 has been launched for sale through an expression of interest (EOI) exercise with an indicative price of $16 million. The price translates to $6,413 psf on the property’s land area of 2,495 sq ft. Colliers, which is marketing the property, says the house has a gross floor area of 5,603 sq ft. item.title: Central Phuket development in Thailand to undergo US$836 mil expansion
item.description: Central Phuket, a landmark mixed-use development in Phuket, Thailand, is set to undergo a US$836 million ($1.06 billion) expansion. Central Pattana, the retail-led real estate arm of Thai conglomerate Central Group, which owns the property, announced on March 2 that the expansion will increase Central Phuket’s total space by 40% to approximately 500,000 sq m (5,382,000 sq ft).
